source.rule: All narrative presence, names, aliases, locations and movements in this analysis are extracted only from the Internet Archive transcription. External sources are not used to establish novel facts.

title: Earth

confirmed_movement_points.evidence: The pair reaches the hills after leaving the battlefield and spends two days foraging there.
They move at night in the direction of Tarui and subsequently reach Oko and Akemi's refuge.
They are taken in and concealed at Oko and Akemi's house.
Takezo goes into the nearby mountains with Akemi to collect mushrooms/for supplies and encounters Temma.
Takezo returns to the house after the encounter.
Otsu spots Takezo among the crowd outside the temple during the flower festival; he immediately disappears.
Takezo is hiding in the Sanumo mountains while search parties pursue him.
Takuan takes Otsu into the mountains and waits for Takezo rather than conducting a conventional search.
Takezo approaches their camp/fire and is captured by Takuan.
Takuan brings the captured Takezo back to Shippoji.
Takezo is tied to the old cryptomeria tree in the temple grounds.
Takezo is freed and escapes with Otsu; they reach Nakayama Pass before separating.
Takezo continues toward Hinagura to find Ogin.
Otsu continues toward Himeji and waits at Hanada Bridge.
Takezo reaches the Himeji area after the failed attempt to find Ogin at Hinagura.
Takuan brings Takezo before Lord Ikeda Terumasa at Himeji Castle.

identity_checkpoint.evidence: At Himeji Castle, Ikeda asks for Shimmen Takezo's name and the later naming scene establishes Miyamoto Musashi.
identity_checkpoint.spoiler_rule: The canonical identity remains the same internal character ID; only the reader-facing identity changes at the narrative point where the new name is established.
